description: Na₄CO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.38 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.49 Å. C is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.42 Å) and two longer (1.44 Å) C-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom.
